terminology_decisions: GameHQ, GameInput, XInput, DualSense, GDI, PNG, HTTPS, executable names, paths, switches, URLs, and placeholders remain protected.
Use direct US English spelling in en-US while stable IDs remain unchanged.
Capture as a noun is a saved screenshot or clip; capture as a verb is recording or saving media.
Replay buffer names rolling recording; playback names viewing existing media.
Input assignments map controls to actions, and selector labels describe the actual choice.
Portable describes the GameHQ package or profile, never the selected folder itself.
Update authorization, signature verification, package identity, recovery, and rollback remain distinct.
Help descriptions use complete natural clauses whenever fragments obscured behavior.
Installer, launcher, Playnite, and release-note text preserves product names, filenames, URLs, and protocols.
calibration_rules: Review every stable ID with its location, UI role, neighbors, placeholders, and protected-token context.
Change canonical English only for a concrete linguistic, contextual, technical, factual, or en-US defect.
Record every source correction as a before/after delta for downstream locale review.
Use concise action labels, complete explanatory sentences, and direct safety-critical warnings.
Structural validity is necessary but never sufficient evidence of linguistic quality.
Revalidate an accepted locale only when its unchanged translation still preserves corrected source meaning.
